comment.hu: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Titkos szavazásra irányuló kérelmek</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A PfE, az ECR és az ESN titkos szavazást kér az 52. és 54. módosításról.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pl: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Wnioski o głosowanie tajne</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grupy PfE, ECR i ESN wystąpiły z wnioskiem o głosowanie tajne nad poprawką 52 i 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fi: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Salaista äänestystä koskevat pyynnöt</title><remarkFreeText><translation>PfE-, ECR- ja ESN-ryhmät pyysivät salaista äänestystä tarkistuksista 52 ja 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Iarrataí ar vótáil le ballóid rúnda</title><remarkFreeText><translation>D’iarr na grúpaí PfE, ECR agus ESN vótáil le ballóid rúnda i gcás leasuithe 52 agus 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.el: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Αιτήματα για μυστική ψηφοφορία</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Οι ομάδες PfE, ECR και ESN υπέβαλαν αίτημα για μυστική ψηφοφορία επί των τροπολογιών 52 και 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.mt: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Talba għal votazzjoni sigrieta</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Il-Gruppi PfE, ECR u ESN talbu votazzjonijiet sigrieti dwar l-emendi 52 u 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Cereri de vot secret</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grupurile PfE, ECR și ESN au depuse cereri de a proceda la vot secret privind amendamentele 52 și 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Richieste di votazione a scrutinio segreto</title><remarkFreeText><translation>I gruppi PfE, ECR e ESN hanno chiesto votazioni a scrutinio segreto sugli emendamenti 52 e 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Žádosti o tajné hlasování</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Skupiny PfE, ECR a ESN požádaly o tajné hlasování o pozměňovacích návrzích 52 a 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.hr: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Zahtjevi za odvojeno glasovanje</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Klubovi zastupnika PfE-a, ECR-a i ESN-a zatražili su odvojeno glasovanje o amandmanima 52. i 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Anmodninger om hemmelige afstemninger</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grupperne PfE, ECR og ESN havde anmodet om hemmelige afstemninger om ændringsforslag 52 og 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Prašymai dėl slapto balsavimo</title><remarkFreeText><translation>PfE, ECR ir ESN frakcijos paprašė balsuoti slaptai dėl 52 ir 54 pakeitimų.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.bg: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Искания за тайно гласуване</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Групите PfE, ECR и ESN поискаха изменения 52 и 54 да бъдат подложени на тайно гласуване.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Pieprasījumi balsot aizklāti</title><remarkFreeText><translation>PfE, ECR un ESN grupa pieprasīja aizklātu balsošanu par grozījumiem Nr. 52 un 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.de: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Anträge auf geheime Abstimmung</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Die Fraktionen PfE, ECR und ESN haben eine geheime Abstimmung über die Änderungsanträge 52 und 54 beantragt.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.nl: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Verzoeken om geheime stemming</title><remarkFreeText><translation>De PfE-, de ECR- en de ESN-Fractie hebben verzocht om een geheime stemming over de amendementen 52 en 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Pedidos de votação por escrutínio secreto</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Os Grupos PfE, ECR e ESN pediram votações por escrutínio secreto sobre as alterações 52 e 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Zahteve za tajno glasovanje</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Skupine PfE, ECR in ESN so zahtevale tajno glasovanje o predlogih sprememb 52 in 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Begäran om sluten omröstning</title><remarkFreeText><translation>PfE-, ECR- och ESN-grupperna begärde sluten omröstning om ändringsförslag 52 och 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Solicitudes de votación secreta</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Los Grupos PfE, ECR y ESN han solicitado la votación secreta de las enmiendas 52 y 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.et: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Taotlus salajaseks hääletuseks</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Fraktsioonid PfE, ECR ja ESN esitasid taotluse salajaseks hääletuseks muudatusettepanekute 52 ja 54 üle.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sk: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Žiadosti o tajné hlasovanie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Skupiny PfE, ECR a ESN požadovali tajné hlasovanie o PN 52 a 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Requests for secret ballot</title><remarkFreeText><translation>The PfE, ECR and ESN groups had requested a secret ballot on Amendments 52 and 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Demandes de vote au scrutin secret</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Les groupes PfE, ECR et ESN ont demandé des votes au scrutin secret sur les amendements 52 et 54.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
